::: {.content-visible when-format="docx"}
# Book_03 — Discovery: The Authentication Audit
:::

::: {.callout-note}
Where Book 02 measured the estate to decide what survives, this book measures the **authentication posture** of what remains. `Get-SQLServerAuthAudit.ps1` is the instrument, the Arc-eligibility classification is its most consequential output, and the per-instance compliance record — not a spreadsheet — is its deliverable.
:::
